question: The HCF and the LCM of two numbers are 24 and 288, respectively. If one of the numbers is 72, find the other one.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Product of two numbers = HCF × LCM

Second Number = (HCF × LCM) ÷ First Number

Second Number = (24 × 288) ÷ 72

Second Number = 288 ÷ 3 = 96

**∴ The correct answer is 96.**
